account.title: Account

card.title: Account and sync
card.body: Optional: sign in to have your data on several devices and kept safe. The app works great without one too.

account.unavailable: Accounts are not enabled in this version of the app. Everything works locally, on your device.
account.intro: Sign in to find your data on another device and keep it safe. Without an account everything stays on this device only.
account.resetSent: If an account exists with this email, we've sent you a link to reset the password.
account.signOutNote: Your data stays on this device.

delete.title: Delete the account?
delete.body: This deletes your account and all your cloud data. It cannot be undone. Data on this device stays: you can delete it separately in Settings.
delete.socialNote: For security you'll be asked to sign in again.

errors.email-in-use: An account with this email already exists.
errors.weak-password: The password is too weak: use at least 6 characters.
errors.network: No connection. Try again when you're online.
errors.too-many-requests: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.requires-recent-login: For security, please confirm your identity again.
errors.account-exists-with-other-provider: An account with this email already exists, created with a different sign-in method.

account.restoreHint: Already have an account? Sign in to get your data back.

status.offline: Offline: it will sync again as soon as the network is back.

merge.title: Merge the data?
merge.body: This account already has cloud data and so does this device. We merge them without deleting anything: here is what happens.
merge.otherAccount: Careful: this device was linked to another account. By merging, the data of the two accounts will be mixed.
merge.corrections: XP will be recalculated for {n} items present on several devices, so nothing counts twice.
merge.backupNote: Before merging I keep a copy of this device's data.
